cases.multiline: 8 newline-joined ordinary tool-output rows, six-digit sequence
cases.long: 8192 ASCII units, six-digit prefix +8186 x characters, no LF

schedule.instrumentation_order: only after all timing, base then candidate; fresh400 +31 accepted20-entry batches to1020 for populated count/text caps; durations retained but not used as timing evidence

boundaries.producer: synthetic actual WebCallbacks.log before each observation; fixture/control creation outside timing
boundaries.http: native fetch through headers plus actual Response.json body/read/parse separately; actual Flask routes in ThreadingHTTPServer loopback; no CDP route replacement for metadata/log
boundaries.publication: test-only PAGE timing insertions: baseline starts before fixed logStatus note mutation, then suffix selection/whole-text append and cursor commit; candidate starts before recentLog.publish, including suffix sizing/staging/anchor/DOM/note/scroll/cursor commit; both end after forced log.scrollHeight layout read
boundaries.cycle: manual refresh to publication+forced layout end, including actual metadata/log fetch+body; completion-chained900ms wait excluded by clearing the pending timer between fixture observations; native15s body deadlines/fences remain
boundaries.initial: actual openJob latest retained snapshot; one cold population per case/source, not a percentile estimate

statistics.median: statistics.median of125 actual observed batches per case/source
statistics.p95: empirical nearest rank sorted[ceil(.95*125)-1] =sorted[118], no interpolation
statistics.checkpoints: separate raw distributions by emissions<=1000,1001..2000,2001..3000; small checkpoint buckets do not replace overall125-sample p95

correctness: after every initial/warmup/observed/instrumented batch, independently simulate producer FIFO count/UTF8 cap and expected display suffix, compare native DOM SHA256 and UTF16 length, authoritative cursor, actual log interval/reset/count, and candidate spans/content/delimiter count+absolute first/last sequence; all raw samples and failed attempts preserved
responsiveness: PerformanceObserver long tasks and timestamped native rAF frame gaps are correlated to recorded publication/cycle boundaries; async DOM hashing/control/validation remain outside timing. At each1000/2000/3000 checkpoint, an idle/post-batch native wheel pulse records request-start→event/frame times and actual displacement with polling stopped. These idle checks do not measure input during publication or rule out stalls; held-body functional user scrolling is separate browser evidence. No whole-browser RSS, engine copy-count, throughput or universal frame claim.
instrumentation: after every timing phase completes, test-only textContent/createTextNode/createElement/createDocumentFragment hooks collect UTF16 units passed to publication and created nodes; report attached state, conservative old+created entry/text-node transient bounds, independent DOM totals. No production instrumentation

escalation.repeated_missed_input_or_stall: root disposition required even below numeric budgets

isolation: task1203 root for every mutable path; copied task-local sitecustomize write/network/profile guard and explicit configure() for standalone driver; selected source and all frozen hashes checked before/after each source/phase. Prepared /tmp binaries/tools read-only. Base runs outside native cwd. Manifest bytes must equal the explicitly granted immutable digest before loading and after each phase; selected web expectation comes from that manifest, not a freshly derived source hash.
pregrant_refinement: Clear healthy completion timer immediately before async DOM hash validation, preventing a900ms automatic empty poll from entering slow validation; no runtime/timing execution.
pregrant_import_refinement: Explicitly assert selected private leaf import path/hash alongside the three top-level selected imports; product/tests unchanged.
supervisor_pregrant_safeguards: manifest itself must equal explicitly supplied TASK1203_GRANTED_HASH before parsing and after phase; selected expected web hash derives from immutable granted manifest
assert actual log.from/base as well as len/count/reset and DOM hash
record cycle/publication start+end timestamps and timestamped rAF gaps, allowing operation-overlap attribution of long tasks/frame gaps
checkpoint native wheel is explicitly idle/post-batch after validation with polling stopped; it does not rule out publication stalls; no under-load input timing claim
unexecuted_versions: Original, timer, pre-review and final manifests retained; no version was executed before root grant.
failure_retention: Every raw record enters the result array before correctness assertions with correct:false until validated; an unconditional error handler writes the full partial array and error stack, in addition to successful case flushes. No failed samples can be discarded by a mid-case assertion. On other errors, capture any uncollected browser timing/transport/frame arrays before closing (bounded1s error snapshot), retain Python timeout output, and verify frozen identity in finally for failed as well as successful phases.
